meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 你让 Claude 处理量子计算任务时,它会用 Python 和 Cirq 框架来搭建、模拟量子电路,还能给电路加噪声模型、做参数扫描,并支持把电路提交到 Google、IonQ 等量子硬件上运行。
howto.when: 当目标是 Google Quantum AI 硬件、设计带噪声的电路,或运行量子表征实验时;也包括用 Python 搭建/模拟 NISQ 电路、做参数扫描或提交量子任务时。

say.text: 用 Cirq 搭一个两比特 Bell 态电路,模拟 1000 次并打印直方图。
say.note: 会生成并运行 Cirq 代码。

say.text: 给这个电路加 depolarizing 噪声,比较不同噪声强度下的结果。
say.note: 会用噪声模型做对比模拟。

say.text: 用 Cirq 把这段参数化电路做成参数扫描,输出各参数的结果。
say.note: 会生成 sweep 代码并汇总结果。

howto.what_en: Claude will write and run Python code using Cirq to build and simulate quantum circuits, add noise models, perform parameter sweeps, and submit circuits to supported quantum hardware such as Google and IonQ.
howto.when_en: When targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, noise-aware circuit design, or quantum characterization experiments. Also when building/simulating NISQ circuits, running parameter sweeps, or submitting to supported backends.

say_en.text: Build a two-qubit Bell state circuit with Cirq, simulate 1000 times, and print the histogram.
Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and compare results at different noise levels.
say_en.note: Uses a noise model for comparison.

say_en.text: Make this parameterized circuit a parameter sweep and output results for each value.
say_en.note: Generates sweep code and summarizes results.
